title: Tour Kennedy Space Center with an astronaut
description: Spend part of a day with a veteran NASA astronaut as your guide at Kennedy Space Center. A small group travels by bus behind the gates, hears firsthand stories over lunch, and explores Space Shuttle Atlantis together. Bring the questions you have always wanted to ask; the most memorable part may be a personal detail no exhibit could tell you.
teaser: Ask an astronaut about life and work beyond Earth.
goodToKnow: The astronaut program is offered periodically. Confirm dates and access; simulator elements can be skipped if unsuitable.
whyItMightDelightYou: The conversation gives the spacecraft and launch pads a human scale.
